```{r}
library(ChIPseeker)
library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggupset) 

```



```{r}
txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene
orgdb <- "org.Mm.eg.db"
```

```{r}
input_file <- "/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/20260729_project3996_project3997/ATAC_analyses_mergedReps/twogroup/comparison1/comparison1_diffacc_edgeR.tsv"
 
#peaks_df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

raw_lines <- readLines(input_file)
raw_lines <- gsub("\\\\t", "\t", raw_lines)   # convert literal \t to real tabs
peaks_df <- read.delim(text = raw_lines, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 
peak_coords <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(peaks_df$peak_id, "\\|"))
peaks_df$chr   <- paste0("chr", peak_coords[, 1])   # add "chr" prefix for UCSC-style TxDb
peaks_df$start <- as.integer(peak_coords[, 2])
peaks_df$end   <- as.integer(peak_coords[, 3])
 
# Standardize column names to match downstream code
peaks_df$log2FoldChange <- peaks_df$logFC
peaks_df$padj           <- peaks_df$FDR
 
 
## ---- 3. Define "changed" peaks --------------------------------------------
 
# Thresholds - adjust to your study design
log2fc_cutoff <- 1      # |log2FC| >= 1  (i.e. >=2-fold change)
padj_cutoff   <- 0.05

#we ignore the padj cutoff
peaks_df$direction <- ifelse(peaks_df$log2FoldChange >=  log2fc_cutoff, "Increased",
                       ifelse(peaks_df$log2FoldChange <= -log2fc_cutoff, "Decreased",
                              "Unchanged"))
 
changed_peaks_df <- subset(peaks_df, direction != "Unchanged")
 
cat("Total peaks:", nrow(peaks_df), "\n")
cat("Peaks with significant change in accessibility:", nrow(changed_peaks_df), "\n")
cat("  Increased:", sum(changed_peaks_df$direction == "Increased"), "\n")
cat("  Decreased:", sum(changed_peaks_df$direction == "Decreased"), "\n")
 
 
## ---- 4. Convert to GRanges and annotate with ChIPseeker -------------------
 
changed_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = changed_peaks_df$chr,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = changed_peaks_df$start, end = changed_peaks_df$end),
  log2FoldChange = changed_peaks_df$log2FoldChange,
  direction      = changed_peaks_df$direction
)
 
# annotatePeak assigns each peak to its nearest gene/genomic feature
# (promoter, 5'UTR, exon, intron, downstream, distal intergenic, etc.)
peakAnno <- annotatePeak(changed_gr,
                          tssRegion = c(-3000, 3000),
                          TxDb = txdb,
                          annoDb = orgdb,
                          level = "gene")
 
peakAnno_df <- as.data.frame(peakAnno)
 
# Save the annotated peak table
write.csv(peakAnno_df, "/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/20260729_project3996_project3997/annotated_changed_peaks.8cells.csv", row.names = FALSE)
 
 
pdf("/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/20260729_project3996_project3997/peak_annotation_summary.8cells.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
plotAnnoBar(peakAnno)
plotDistToTSS(peakAnno)
upsetplot(peakAnno)
dev.off()

```

#Do some GO annotation
```{r}
input_file <- "/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/20260729_project3996_project3997/annotated_changed_peaks.8cells.csv"
 
peakAnno_df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 
# geneId column holds Entrez IDs as ChIPseeker/annotatePeak assigns them.
# Coerce to character (it may be read as numeric/integer for some rows).
peakAnno_df$geneId <- as.character(peakAnno_df$geneId)
 
## ---- 3. Build gene lists ---------------------------------------------------
 
# Unique Entrez IDs, split by direction of accessibility change.
# (A gene can appear more than once if multiple peaks map to it - dedupe.)
genes_all  <- unique(na.omit(peakAnno_df$geneId))
genes_up   <- unique(na.omit(peakAnno_df$geneId[peakAnno_df$direction == "Increased"]))
genes_down <- unique(na.omit(peakAnno_df$geneId[peakAnno_df$direction == "Decreased"]))
 
cat("Unique genes near changed peaks:", length(genes_all), "\n")
cat("  Near increased-accessibility peaks:", length(genes_up), "\n")
cat("  Near decreased-accessibility peaks:", length(genes_down), "\n")
 
 
## ---- 4. Run GO enrichment (clusterProfiler::enrichGO) ---------------------
 
run_GO <- function(gene_ids, ontology = "BP") {
  if (length(gene_ids) < 3) {
    warning("Fewer than 3 genes provided - skipping GO test for this set.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  enrichGO(gene          = gene_ids,
           OrgDb         = orgdb,
           keyType       = "ENTREZID",
           ont           = ontology,     # "BP", "MF", "CC", or "ALL"
           pAdjustMethod = "BH",
           pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
           qvalueCutoff  = 0.2,
           readable      = TRUE)
}
 
# Biological Process enrichment for all changed peaks, and split by direction
ego_all  <- run_GO(genes_all,  ontology = "BP")
ego_up   <- run_GO(genes_up,   ontology = "BP")
ego_down <- run_GO(genes_down, ontology = "BP")
 
## ---- 5. Save result tables --------------------------------------------------
 
if (!is.null(ego_all))  write.csv(as.data.frame(ego_all),  "/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/20260729_project3996_project3997/GO_BP_all_changed_peaks.8cells.csv",  row.names = FALSE)
if (!is.null(ego_up))   write.csv(as.data.frame(ego_up),   "/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/20260729_project3996_project3997/GO_BP_increased_peaks.8cells.csv",    row.names = FALSE)
if (!is.null(ego_down)) write.csv(as.data.frame(ego_down), "/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/20260729_project3996_project3997/GO_BP_decreased_peaks.8cells.csv",    row.names = FALSE)
 
 
## ---- 6. Visualize GO results ------------------------------------------------
 
pdf("/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/20260729_project3996_project3997/GO_enrichment_plots.8cells.pdf", width = 9, height = 7)
 
if (!is.null(ego_all) && nrow(as.data.frame(ego_all)) > 0) {
  print(dotplot(ego_all, showCategory = 20, title = "GO BP - All changed peaks"))
 
  # Collapse redundant/similar GO terms for a cleaner enrichment map
  ego_all_simplified <- simplify(ego_all, cutoff = 0.7, by = "p.adjust", select_fun = min)
  print(emapplot(pairwise_termsim(ego_all_simplified), showCategory = 20))
}
 
if (!is.null(ego_up) && nrow(as.data.frame(ego_up)) > 0) {
  print(dotplot(ego_up, showCategory = 20, title = "GO BP - Increased accessibility"))
}
 
if (!is.null(ego_down) && nrow(as.data.frame(ego_down)) > 0) {
  print(dotplot(ego_down, showCategory = 20, title = "GO BP - Decreased accessibility"))
}
 
dev.off()
 
cat("\nDone. Outputs written:\n",
    " - GO_BP_all_changed_peaks.csv\n",
    " - GO_BP_increased_peaks.csv\n",
    " - GO_BP_decreased_peaks.csv\n",
    " - GO_enrichment_plots.pdf\n")
 
```
##########
Run enrichGo on cluster_3 SCR vs MOF
```{r}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# Load required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Mm.eg.db)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# 1. File path
bed_file <- "/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/20260729_project3996_project3997/ATAC_analyses_mergedReps/bw/20260811_8cell_SCRvsMOF.cluster3.closestGene.bed"

# 2. Read file and extract genes from Column 17
df <- read.table(bed_file, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Column 17 split by ";"
gene_info <- strsplit(df$V17, ";")
ensembl_raw <- sapply(gene_info, function(x) x[1])

# Strip version suffix (e.g., ENSMUSG00000046337.17 -> ENSMUSG00000046337)
ensembl_clean <- sub("\\..*", "", ensembl_raw)
unique_genes <- unique(na.omit(ensembl_clean))

cat(sprintf("Extracted %d unique Ensembl Gene IDs from Column 17.\n", length(unique_genes)))

# 3. Run enrichGO for Biological Process (BP)
ego_bp <- enrichGO(
  gene          = unique_genes,
  OrgDb         = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType       = "ENSEMBL",
  ont           = "BP",               # Options: "BP" (Biological Process), "MF", "CC", or "ALL"
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.2
)

# 4. Save CSV and generate Dotplot
if (!is.null(ego_bp) && nrow(as.data.frame(ego_bp)) > 0) {
  # Simplify redundant terms
  ego_bp_simple <- simplify(ego_bp, cutoff = 0.7, by = "p.adjust", select_fun = min)
  
  # Save tables
  write.csv(as.data.frame(ego_bp), "cluster3_GO_BP_all.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(as.data.frame(ego_bp_simple), "cluster3_GO_BP_simplified.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Save Dotplot visualization
  p <- dotplot(ego_bp_simple, showCategory = 15) + 
       ggtitle("GO Biological Process: Cluster 3 Closest Genes") +
       theme_minimal()
       
  ggsave("cluster3_GO_BP_dotplot.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  cat("Saved GO results to 'cluster3_GO_BP_simplified.csv' and 'cluster3_GO_BP_dotplot.png'.\n")
} else {
  cat("No significantly enriched GO terms found at pvalueCutoff = 0.05.\n")
}
```
